note: Expected findings are the code, path, message and suggestion `orb validate` (the Rust validator) reports for the same program. Added cases copy page.rs param_shape_collision_fires_once_through_validate_comprehensive_full and different_param_shapes_do_not_collide, and follow validate_page_path_uniqueness for three pages and two orbitals. The real-program-shape cases feed a lowered std atom to the rule: the rule must reach LINT_FINISH (a runtime type error in the findings expression leaves the transition without it). The collision key is per protocol, as the compiler computes it: a route is keyed `route <param-shape path>`, an addressed endpoint `<protocol> <its address entries as key=value, sorted, with a literal path param-shaped>`, and an endpoint with no address has no key, so it collides with nothing.

program.name: std-reminder-scheduler
program.description: std-reminder-scheduler — deadline reminders for a target entity. A periodic tick scans the target for records whose `dateField` deadline (a ms-epoch number or an ISO datetime string) is within `offsetHours` of now and that have not been reminded yet, and emits `ReminderDue` for each — every matching record, via a self-driving scan loop. `direction` picks which side of now the scan matches: 'future' (default) fires for deadlines up to `offsetHours` ahead; 'past' fires once a record's date is at least `offsetHours` behind now. Marks each record `remindedAt` so it isn't reminded twice — and only when the record actually matched the scan, so records outside the window stay eligible for later passes. Compose alongside std-notify-on-event to deliver the reminder.

fields.name: targetEntity
fields.description: The entity to which the reminder applies.

fields.name: recordCount
fields.description: The number of records processed during this run.

fields.name: ranAt
fields.description: Timestamp indicating when the process was executed.

fields.name: errors
fields.description: Records any errors encountered during processing.

fields.name: dueAt
fields.description: Deadline timestamp (also lets the standalone default target validate).

fields.name: remindedAt
fields.description: When this record was last reminded — the dedup marker; 0 = not yet reminded.

fields.name: headId
fields.description: Scratch: id of the record the scan loop is currently reminding.

offsetHours.label: How many hours before the deadline to remind?
offsetHours.description: A reminder fires once the deadline is within this many hours of now.
offsetHours.synonyms: advance notice, lead time, heads up, early warning hours, how far ahead

enabled.label: Send deadline reminders
enabled.description: Automatically remind about upcoming deadlines. Off by default.
enabled.synonyms: enable, turn on, activate, switch on, reminders, deadline reminders, due-date reminders, advance notice, heads up, nudge before due

direction.label: Scan which side of now?
direction.description: 'future' (default) matches records whose dateField is still ahead, up to offsetHours out — upcoming-deadline reminders. 'past' matches records whose dateField is at least offsetHours behind now — act-after-the-fact policies. The emitted event and the dedup marker are identical either way.
direction.synonyms: direction, past due, overdue, after the deadline, look back, backward scan, past-window

targetEntity.label: Target entity
targetEntity.description: Entity to scan for upcoming deadlines (e.g. 'Task', 'ClassSession'). Defaults to the atom's own log so the standalone validates; rebind per composition. Typed `entity`, so a rename of the bound entity threads through to this value automatically.
targetEntity.synonyms: entity to monitor, entity to watch, record type, object type

severity.label: How urgent are the reminders?
severity.description: Severity passed to the notifier: info / warning / error.
severity.synonyms: urgency level, priority, importance, alert level, how urgent

template.label: What should the reminder message say?
template.description: Message body passed to the notifier.
template.synonyms: message text, reminder body, notification copy, alert message, what to say

dateField.label: Which date field is the deadline?
dateField.description: Field on the target entity holding the deadline (e.g. 'dueAt', 'startsAt'). Accepts a ms-epoch number or an ISO datetime string; both are coerced to ms-epoch for comparison.
dateField.synonyms: due date field, timestamp field, cutoff field, expiry field, when it's due
